description: A fictional cartoon science-fiction toy plasma gadget, a long chunky toy-like game prop (not a real object, no working parts). A long off-white rounded body, thicker at the rear. In front of it a long round mid grey tube wrapped by four evenly spaced bright cyan rings, ending in a flared mid grey trumpet cone with a dark open centre. On top of the body a horizontal clear glass cylinder tank lying lengthwise, filled flat bright magenta, with mid grey end caps, held above the body by two mid grey clamp bands. Under the middle of the body a dark purple handle raked backward with a flared foot, and in front of it a small bright orange curved finger lever inside a rounded mid grey loop. Further forward, under the rearmost cyan ring of the tube, a short dark purple upright round front handle with a flared foot. At the rear, behind a mid grey collar, a stubby dark purple shoulder piece that widens to a rounded end pad. On the left flank of the body near the rear, three short bright orange slots stacked one above the other. A small bright orange round knob is on the right flank of the body.
proportions: About 0.85 m long, 0.12 m wide and 0.28 m tall. (length : width : height = 7.08 : 1 : 2.33)
sides: the three orange slots are on the left flank only; the small orange round knob is on the right flank only; everything else is symmetric left to right.
